test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 8 Sept 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: A sum of Rs. 5,800 is invested at 6% per annum simple interest. How much will the sum become after 4 years?
solution:
**Given:**

Principal (P) = Rs. 5,800

Rate of Interest (R) = 6% per annum

Time (T) = 4 years

**Formula Used:**

Simple Interest (SI) = (P × R × T) / 100

Amount (A) = Principal (P) + Simple Interest (SI)

**Calculation:**

Simple Interest (SI) = (5800 × 6 × 4) / 100

⇒ SI = 1392

Amount (A) = 5800 + 1392

⇒ A = 7192

**The sum will become Rs. 7,192 after 4 years.**
